욥기 15:1.content: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said,

욥기 15:2.content: Should a wise man utter vain knowledge, and fill his belly with the east wind?

욥기 15:3.content: Should he reason with unprofitable talk? or with speeches wherewith he can do no good?

욥기 15:4.content: Yea, thou castest off fear, and restrainest prayer before God.

욥기 15:5.content: For thy mouth uttereth thine iniquity, and thou choosest the tongue of the crafty.

욥기 15:6.content: Thine own mouth condemneth thee, and not I: yea, thine own lips testify against thee.

욥기 15:7.content: Art thou the first man that was born? or wast thou made before the hills?

욥기 15:8.content: Hast thou heard the secret of God? and dost thou restrain wisdom to thyself?

욥기 15:9.content: What knowest thou, that we know not? what understandest thou, which is not in us?

욥기 15:10.content: With us are both the grayheaded and very aged men, much elder than thy father.

욥기 15:11.content: Are the consolations of God small with thee? is there any secret thing with thee?

욥기 15:12.content: Why doth thine heart carry thee away? and what do thy eyes wink at,

욥기 15:13.content: That thou turnest thy spirit against God, and lettest such words go out of thy mouth?

욥기 15:14.content: What is man, that he should be clean? and he which is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?

욥기 15:15.content: Behold, he putteth no trust in his saints; yea, the heavens are not clean in his sight.

욥기 15:16.content: How much more abominable and filthy is man, which drinketh iniquity like water?

욥기 15:17.content: I will shew thee, hear me; and that which I have seen I will declare;

욥기 15:18.content: Which wise men have told from their fathers, and have not hid it:

욥기 15:19.content: Unto whom alone the earth was given, and no stranger passed among them.

욥기 15:20.content: The wicked man travaileth with pain all his days, and the number of years is hidden to the oppressor.

욥기 15:21.content: A dreadful sound is in his ears: in prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him.

욥기 15:22.content: He believeth not that he shall return out of darkness, and he is waited for of the sword.

욥기 15:23.content: He wandereth abroad for bread, saying, Where is it? he knoweth that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.

욥기 15:24.content: Trouble and anguish shall make him afraid; they shall prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.

욥기 15:25.content: For he stretcheth out his hand against God, and strengtheneth himself against the Almighty.

욥기 15:26.content: He runneth upon him, even on his neck, upon the thick bosses of his bucklers:

욥기 15:27.content: Because he covereth his face with his fatness, and maketh collops of fat on his flanks.

욥기 15:28.content: And he dwelleth in desolate cities, and in houses which no man inhabiteth, which are ready to become heaps.

욥기 15:29.content: He shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue, neither shall he prolong the perfection thereof upon the earth.

욥기 15:30.content: He shall not depart out of darkness; the flame shall dry up his branches, and by the breath of his mouth shall he go away.

욥기 15:31.content: Let not him that is deceived trust in vanity: for vanity shall be his recompence.

욥기 15:32.content: It shall be accomplished before his time, and his branch shall not be green.

욥기 15:33.content: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and shall cast off his flower as the olive.

욥기 15:34.content: For the congregation of hypocrites shall be desolate, and fire shall consume the tabernacles of bribery.

욥기 15:35.content: They conceive mischief, and bring forth vanity, and their belly prepareth deceit.
